description: List the account's balance transaction ledger, newest first: top-ups, refunds, disputes, phone rent, provisioning fees, activation fees, and verification upcharges. amount_cents is always the credit, before tax. A top-up that was charged sales tax also carries tax_cents (the GST/HST) and charged_cents (what the card paid, amount_cents plus tax_cents). Per-message SMS costs are NOT included here: see list_messages/get_message for those.

account_id.description: Your account ID. Omit it and it is resolved from your API key.

before.description: Id of the oldest transaction already seen: returns the next (older) page.
